{{italic title}}

'''''The Art of Mathematics''''' ({{Korean|hangul=수학의 정석|rr=suhak-ui jeongseok}}), written by {{ill|Hong Sung-Dae|ko|홍성대|vertical-align=sup}}, is a series of mathematics textbooks for high school students in South Korea. First published in 1966, it is the best-selling book series in South Korea, with about 46 million copies sold as of 2016.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/opinion/column/898987.html|title='수학의 정석' / 김영배|last=Kim|date=23 June 2019 |publisher=The Hankyoreh|accessdate=2019-08-17}}</ref> In [[Jeongeup]], [[North Jeolla Province]], the hometown of Hong Sung-Dae, a street is named Suhakjeongseok-gil ({{langx|ko|수학정석길|links=no}}) in honor of the author.'<ref>{{Coord|35|39|10|N|126|56|34|E}}</ref>

== Controversy ==
The similarities with the Japanese Textbook series {{ill|Chart-Style Math|jp|チャート式|vertical-align=sup}} ({{Langx|ja|チャート式数学}}) have caused the author to receive accusations of plagiarism.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://monthly.chosun.com/client/mdaily/daily_view.asp?idx=7247&Newsnumb=2019067247|title=[金成東의 인간탐험] 수학의 定石 저자 洪性大 상산학원 이사장|date=2019-06-20|website=monthly.chosun.com|language=ko|access-date=2019-08-17}}</ref> The chapter division, style of explanation, and formatting are visibly similar between the books. For instance, in the Japanese books, the order of questions are in "Example Questions, Practice Questions, Exercise Questions," while in The Art of Mathematics it is "Example Questions, Similar Questions, Practice Questions".  The author Hong has denied all accusations, although he has admitted that the questions in the books were selected from 20 reference books around the world.

==Major topics in the 11th edition==
Changes in the 11th edition, published 2013–2015, reflect the {{ill|2009 revision of South Korea's National Curriculum|ko|2009 개정 교육과정|vertical-align=sup}}. Each of the six volumes consist of two versions, one for average students ({{Korean|hangul=기본편|rr=Gibonpyeon|labels=no}}) and one for higher-ability students ({{Korean|hangul=실력편|rr=Silyeokpyeon|labels=no}}).<ref>{{cite web |title=2014년도 적용 새 교육 과정 안내 |url=https://www.sungji.com/Event/Lecture_2014_Info.aspx |accessdate=2015-07-16 |publisher=Sung Ji Publications}}</ref>

===Mathematics I===
{{langx|ko|수학 I|links=no|label=none}}
*[[Polynomial]]s (다항식)
*[[Equation]]s and [[Inequality (mathematics)|Inequalities]] (방정식과 부등식)
*[[Graph of a function|Graphs of Equations]] (방정식의 그래프)

===Mathematics II===
{{langx|ko|수학 II|links=no|label=none}}
*[[Set (mathematics)|Sets]] and [[Proposition (mathematics)|Propositions]] (집합과 명제)
*[[Function (mathematics)|Functions]] (함수 ham-soo)
*[[Sequence]]s (수열 soo-yeul)
*[[Exponentiation|Exponents]] and [[Logarithm]]s (지수와 로그함수)

===Probability and statistics===
{{langx|ko|확률과 통계|links=no|label=none}}
*[[Permutation]]s and [[Combination (mathematics)|Combinations]] (순열과 조합)
*[[Probability]] (확률)
*[[Statistics]] (통계)

===Calculus I===
{{langx|ko|미적분 I|links=no|label=none}}
*[[Limit of a sequence|Limits of Sequences]] (수열의 극한)
*[[Continuous function|Limits and Continuity]] (극한과 연속성)
*[[Differential calculus|Differentiation of Polynomial Functions]] (다항식의 미분)
*[[Integral|Integration of Polynomial Functions]] (다항식의 적분)

===Calculus II===
{{langx|ko|미적분 II|links=no|label=none}}
*Exponential and Logarithmic Functions (지수와 로그 함수)
*[[Trigonometric functions|Trigonometric Functions]] (삼각함수)
*Differentiation (미분)
*Integration (적분)

===Geometry and Vectors===
{{langx|ko|기하와 벡터|links=no|label=none}}
*[[Plane curve|Plane Curves]] (평면곡선)
*Vectors in the Plane (평면 벡터)
*Graphs and [[Vector space|Vectors]] in Space (공간의 그래프와 벡터)
